summary: A Quote and a Depth holder on one instrument: the detailed packet's trade price (1500.25) reaches the Quote holder; the snapquote, whose average (1499.10) is no trade price, reaches the Depth holder alone, with the last real price and its average as average_price (R107-07).

notes: The web streams the Quote holder's detailed channel and the Depth holder's snapquote (plus compact); its Depth frame takes the last price either price channel brought (_note_ltp), here the detailed packet's 1500.25. The desktop moves the instrument to Depth, adding the snapquote beside the detailed stream the Quote holder has (R107-07).

deviations.reason: Pocketful's compact and detailed packets carry the last trade time (last_traded_time, epoch seconds, packet_decoder.py); the web's frames leave it out since a1d539764 (pocketful_adapter.py _handle_compact_data, _handle_detailed_data): market data the broker sent, lost. The desktop sends it as ltt in epoch milliseconds, the unit the docs give every WebSocket time.

The detailed packet carries the book's totals (total_buy_quantity and total_sell_quantity, packet_decoder.py _DETAILED at bytes 38 and 46); the web's Quote frame leaves them out (pocketful_adapter.py _handle_detailed_data; its Depth frame names the snapquote's as totalbuyqty and totalsellqty): market data the broker sent, lost. The desktop's Quote frame keeps them.

The desktop's Quote frame keeps them.

The web's listener sends the Quote holder the snapquote's Depth dict, a richer topic's publish for a lower holder (websocket_proxy/server.py zmq_listener). A snapquote brings no trade price, so the desktop sends that holder no frame for it; its book reaches the Depth holder with the last real price.
